record.original_question: Develop general lower bounds for the degree of higher secant varieties, analogous in spirit to the lower-bound framework used for second secant varieties.

evidence.quote: Problem 7. Provide lower bounds for the degree of higher secant varieties, in the spirit of [CR06].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^N$ be a non-degenerate irreducible projective variety over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. For each integer $s \geq 1$, the $s$-th secant variety of $X$ is defined as
$$\sigma_s(X) \;=\; \overline{\bigcup_{x_1,\dots,x_s \in X} \langle x_1,\dots,x_s \rangle} \;\subset\; \mathbb{P}^N,$$
i.e. the Zariski closure of the union of all linear spans of $s$ points of $X$. Assume that $\sigma_s(X)$ is a proper subvariety of $\mathbb{P}^N$ (equivalently, $X$ is not $s$-defective in the sense that $\sigma_s(X)$ fills the ambient space).

For $s = 2$, there is a known general lower bound for $\deg \sigma_2(X)$ expressed in terms of invariants of $X$ (such as $\dim X$, $\deg X$, and the codimension of $\sigma_2(X)$), obtained via a refinement of Terracini's lemma.

Problem: Develop, in the same spirit, general lower bounds for $\deg \sigma_s(X)$ for arbitrary $s \geq 2$, expressed in terms of intrinsic invariants of $X$ and of the embedding $X \hookrightarrow \mathbb{P}^N$, and which reduce (up to the appropriate specialization) to the known bound when $s = 2$.
artifact.status_search_result: A search reveals work on degrees of second secant varieties (notably refinements of Terracini's lemma giving sharp lower bounds for $\deg \sigma_2(X)$), and on dimensions/degrees of higher secants in special cases (Segre, Veronese, Segre–Veronese), but no general lower bound framework for $\deg \sigma_s(X)$ for arbitrary $s$ analogous to the $s=2$ case appears in the literature. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Varieties with minimal secant degree and linear systems of maximal dimension on surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp lower bound for the degree of (higher) secant varieties via a refinement of Terracini's Lemma.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes lower bound framework primarily for second secant varieties; the higher secant case is not addressed in full generality.

status_evidence.title: On the dimension of higher secant varieties of Segre varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Studies dimensions of higher secant varieties of Segre varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Higher secant variety research focuses largely on dimension or special cases, not general degree lower bounds.
